findings.body: Return mode bounds the input JSON at MAX_BYTES, but then serializes the parsed report with demo.canonical, whose default JSON encoding escapes non-ASCII characters. The serialized artifact can therefore exceed MAX_BYTES even when the input and all report fields are valid. For example, an allowed one-line selection containing 10,000 copies of U+0080 can be cited once in each of 20 findings: the literal UTF-8 excerpts occupy approximately 400,000 input bytes, while their canonical escaped representation alone occupies 1,200,000 bytes. Citation validation limits the number of lines, not their character count. Return mode writes and exports this larger report without checking its final size. Such a result cannot pass verification: receive rejects an archive above MAX_BYTES, and, even if the archive fits, the subsequent demo.file_map rejects the restored report above MAX_BYTES. Check the canonical artifact size before export and keep the sender and receiver limits consistent, so a successful return cannot produce an unverifiable report.
